## Direction

The diagram can be rendered in different directions using the `direction` statement. Valid values are:

- `TB` - Top to Bottom (default)
- `BT` - Bottom to Top
- `LR` - Left to Right
- `RL` - Right to Left
normativeProvenance.meaning: Explicit requirement direction sets the rendered global direction. LR/RL/TB/BT remain visual obligations independently of relationship arrow semantics. Branching/cyclic rank observability is a separate observer qualification, never a reason to discard the source request.

finding: The generic flowchart-only direction projection silently made an explicit requirement layout request advisory. A fresh independent saved-image review found the native two-node output vertical for source direction LR; the previous positive did not check this authored fact.
limits: Only requirement direction is restored. Complex direction observability must remain unknown unless independently qualified; this change imposes neither arbitrary per-edge precedence on other families nor a renderer-specific layout skin.
